item.title: Learn
item.content:
learn.hax.cloud is where the tutorials live. It is still filling in, so some channels have more on than others.

What is on

Each channel is for one kind of person. Every tutorial ends where you can try the thing yourself.

Make and edit pages, add blocks, change the look.

Build blocks and themes, and ship them to every HAX site.

Host and run sites, from one to hundreds.

Operate HAX for a person, correctly and accessibly.

Other ways in

  • Start in your browser at browser.hax.cloud
  • Follow the commands on Get started
  • Read how the pieces fit at hax.cloud
